The '''Corona House Gardens''' was a public park that surrounded [[Corona House/Legends|Corona House]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Description==
The Corona House Gardens was a public park, 80 [[Hectare/Legends|hectares]] large in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], surrounding the house of Corellia's chief executive, Corona House.<ref name="SoF" />

==History==
Formerly a private part of the estate, the gardens were converted to serve as a venue for formal events, such as weddings. In [[18 ABY/Legends]], the [[Human League]], a [[Humanocentrism|human-supremacist]] group held torch-light marches through the gardens on a nightly basis, where they sang anti-[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and anti-[[Alien/Legends|alien]] songs.<ref name="Ambush at Corellia">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>
